registration: local protocol on previously examined historical data; not independent external confirmation

archive.ownership: one archive per market, reused by its twelve monthly tasks

target.observable_normalization: 2017 only; same load, price and stress scales throughout each market, including the source archive
target.physics: StoragePhysics unchanged; reserve adjustment and balancing share one hourly gross-energy power budget
target.verifier: unchanged fixed shortlist of three, 80 all-success iid starts per tested candidate; familywise delta 0.05

analysis.primary_contrast: source_best_z minus standardized_generic_dct_maximin in certified true-feasible deployment
analysis.pairing: same market, month, algorithm seed; algorithm repeats averaged within each actual market-month task
analysis.inference: report all markets and five geographic regions; descriptive paired region bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 202609302; shared calendars preclude a population iid claim
analysis.cost: source archive once per market; average repeat costs within market-month, then sum actual twelve monthly deployments; no hypothetical M=20
analysis.diagnostic_truth: finite empirical verification-window population evaluated after shortlist and certification; neither selection nor source matching uses this truth
analysis.decision: retain every registered market and arm; no threshold, source-period, library, metric or cost retuning after outcomes; negative or mixed results remain separate from the paper
